Market today: The mood is cautious for tech and growth, largely driven by Tesla's slump and the looming threat of a 6% 30-year Treasury yield. This setup is a direct headwind for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-46.24%) and SPAL (-55.51%) are bleeding heavily; both are leveraged, decaying ETFs, and SPAL is a brand-new, very volatile IPO. QQQ (-4.26%) and QQQI (-6.52%) are also nearing their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on the 30-year Treasury yield for any moves towards 6%, and be ready to respect the stops on QQQ (670) and QQQI (52).

Bottom line: Risk management is paramount right now; protect your capital by respecting stops and re-evaluating leveraged positions.
plays: Respect stops: QQQ at 670 and QQQI at 52. Do not let these breach without action.
Review leveraged ETFs: SOXL (-46.24%) and SPAL (-55.51%) are decaying and deep in the red; consider trimming or exiting these volatile positions.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market sentiment and your current drawdowns suggest prioritizing risk management over new entries.
